svg.title: I1 reference CMJ: emergent phases, latent states and simulated devices
svg.desc: Forward-dynamics countermovement jump of a declared hypothetical adult. Latent model states are separated from simulated force-plate and cable-LPT exports and from detector estimates.
svg.text: I1 reference CMJ: emergent phases, latent states and simulated devices

g.text: (a) Model postures at latent events (stick figure; HAT = head-arms-trunk)
(b) Vertical ground reaction: latent vs plate export
plate Fz samples (every 4th; native clock, nominal offset)
(d) Extensor excitation (dashed) and activation (solid): LATENT HYPOTHESIS, not EMG
(e) System COM vertical velocity: latent vs force-derived
integrated plate force (detector; v=0 at backdated onset)
(f) Hip-belt cable LPT: cable displacement is not COM displacement
(g) COP: latent vs plate export (missing when Fz < 20 N)

svg.text: Detector minus latent event times (simulated devices, default noise):
kinetic_onset->onset_threshold: +8.0 ms; kinetic_onset->onset_backdated: -22.0 ms; peak_downward_velocity->peak_downward_velocity: +1.4 ms; com_velocity_reversal->velocity_reversal: +1.2 ms;
takeoff->takeoff: +0.3 ms; com_velocity_reversal->lpt_velocity_reversal: -27.3 ms; com_velocity_reversal->lpt_lowest_point: -28.3 ms; takeoff->lpt_takeoff: NOT_EVALUABLE;
Shaded bands = latent phases from model state predicates (not scheduled). Landing is not modeled: runs end at foot-ground contact.
